name: audio_nothing_is_saved
description: No audio class has GetGZCLSID and save-records.md contains no audio record. After a load every automaton's +0x8C is 0 and no sound is playing, including for an automaton that was mid-state; the pool, the AEMS banks' loaded state, the Hit and freshness players and the radio's playlist position are runtime-only. Because HandleEnterState is the only place StartSFX is called, a loaded automaton already inside a sounding state is silent until it next changes state [quirk 9].
